title: UAE Announces Withdrawal from OPEC & OPEC+ Alliance Effective May 1, 2026
summary: UAE exits OPEC alliance over production quota constraints (4.8M bpd capacity vs 3.2M bpd quota), reducing OPEC to 11 members.
